action.objective: I want to verify e4f5, taking on f5 to open the e-file, which the broad search ranks first, before deciding whether to commit.
action.rationale: The broad search at depth 2 puts e4f5 first with an exact 447; its line e4xf5 exf5 seems to give White a passed pawn on f5 and pressure down the e-file, and after exf5 the d4-pawn is still weak. Its only issue is that Black recaptures with the e6-pawn. This is a single-candidate verification within the reserved allowance, so I can then compare it with the other candidates.
